text: Pazopanib is a potent multi-tyrosine kinase inhibitor that directly binds to the intracellular ATP-binding pocket of KDR (VEGFR-2), effectively inhibiting its autophosphorylation and downstream signaling pathways. In Renal Cell Carcinoma, this interaction blocks VEGF-mediated angiogenesis, thereby depriving the tumor of the blood supply necessary for growth and progression. This mechanism is well-documented and serves as a primary basis for the clinical efficacy of Pazopanib in treating advanced renal cell carcinoma.
